text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the Japan Derby! The 
atmosphere is definitely a bit tense, huh?

Agnes Tachyon simply shrugged as if it 
were someone else's problem. There was 
something I wanted to ask her.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I was just a little concerned. Her 
running form... felt different from usual.

—In the end, the day arrived without me 
ever finding out the truth behind the 'way 
of running' that Manhattan Cafe had let 
slip.
choice_data_list: How has your running style changed?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Good grief! That again?! I thought I told 
you that Cafe simply misunderstood.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Besides... even if it's not a 
misunderstanding, if I haven't spoken of 
it, it simply means the time has not yet 
come.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The only thing you need concern yourself 
with is how well I can run today—and that 
alone—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Even if your attention is drawn to other 
things, would there be any meaningful 
point in doing so?

Agnes Tachyon tilts her head with a 
quizzical "Hm?", leaving me at a loss for 
words.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If there's no point—no, even if there is, 
we are not speaking of this for a while. 
Understand?

Saying that, she left the waiting room 
without any explanation after all.
